items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Use AI resources for your Copilot extensions
items.description: Using the AI resources provides several benefits: Reduced operational overhead : Avoid the need to handle infrastructure management, updates, monitoring, troubleshooting, or maintenance of custom Azure OpenAI subscriptions. This benefit frees up resources to focus on core business operations and provides value-adding intellectual property (IP) to customers. Simplified onboarding : Quickly integrate AI capabilities into your solutions without having to navigate the complexities of setting up and managing your own Azure OpenAI subscription. Improved reliability : Proactive scaling, throttling, load balancing, and fault tolerance measures ensure consistent performance during peak demand. Enhanced security compliance : Built-in compliance measures and governance, including robust protection from malicious and harmful content, ensure compliance with data residency requirements. This benefit reduces the burden of ensuring regulatory compliance for ISVs. Streamlined experience for customers : Customers get a seamless AI resource management process without maintaining different configurations for separate ISV solutions. This capability also provides a cohesive AI consumption tracking and billing experience for Business Central customers. Customers who use AI resources across multiple AI-enabled solutions built with Business Central customer developer tools for Copilot benefit from a unified approach to AI consumption monitoring and invoicing. They don't need to reconcile multiple invoices or metrics from separate ISVs. For details on billing costs, see AI tools at Message scenarios . For most publishers, the default Business Central AI resources are enough. However, if you need specific models, including fine-tuned models, that the Business Central AI resources don't provide, you can bring your own subscription for customers. In this case, the publisher is responsible for deploying, maintaining, scaling, and securing the service. The publisher also handles billing AI resources to customers. We recommend using the developer toolkit AI resources when you extend Copilot in Business Central. You just need to authenticate with the SetManagedResourceAuthorization method in the AI Module AzureOpenAI codeunit. You also provide your own Azure OpenAI subscription details, but the authentication process doesn't use them. (Update 2026 release wave 1: There's now a new method signature for SetManagedResources that doesn't require you to provide your subscription details anymore. You should use that going forward.) // Example of using the default toolkit AI resources in AL AzureOpenAI.SetManagedResourceAuthorization(Enum::"AOAI Model Type"::"Chat Completions",AzureOpenAIAccountName,AzureOpenAIApiKey,AOAIDeployments.GetGPT4oLatest()); To use your own subscription, authenticate it with the SetAuthorization method. // Example of using your own Azure OpenAI subscription in AL AzureOpenAI.SetAuthorization(Enum::"AOAI Model Type"::"Chat Completions",GetEndpoint(),GetDeployment(),GetApiKey()); This AI billing model isn't designed to replace the existing Marketplace monetization pathway for publishers who create Business Central apps. Instead, it offers another option that simplifies AI consumption for customers and partners. ISVs can use the Marketplace monetization option to monetize their IP. Business Value: A key feature of the developer tools for Copilot in Business Central is that publishers in their Marketplace apps use large language models through Microsoft-managed Azure OpenAI resources when they extend Copilot in Business Central. This approach eliminates the need for customers to independently get and manage Azure OpenAI subscriptions. Using the Business Central AI resources is the default and recommended approach. However, some partners or customers might have special requirements that require them to use their own Azure OpenAI subscription when running the feature in production or when developing and testing in sandboxes, which is also supported in the developer tools for Copilot in Business Central. Enabled for: Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Data: Agents and Copilot - Increase AI accuracy by grounding agents in customer insights
items.description: The Customer Insights MCP server allows AI agents and chat experiences to access and understand insights generated by Customer Insights - Data. The Customer Insights MCP server uses the industry-standard MCP architecture to securely share unified profiles and insights with AI agents and chat experiences, providing the data context so AI agents can do their best work. AI tools can use the Customer Insights MCP server to: Resolve Dataverse contacts and leads to their unified customer profile. Access extended customer information unified by Customer Insights - Data from external sources not available to Dataverse. Understand calculated measures for a customer such as their purchase totals over the last 4 months, or the date of their most recent engagement. Quickly discover what segments the customer is a member of. See if a customer has multiple redundant contacts in your system, and which is considered authoritative for that customer. Get predictive insights for the customer such as Customer Lifetime Value (CLV) and Churn risk, giving you greater insights into the customer's current relationships with your company. Scenario Sally is a seller who is evaluating a lead named Joe who recently attended a product launch webinar. Sally asks her AI embedded on their Contact and Lead forms if there are any insights about this lead and is delighted to find that the lead Joe is matched to a VIP customer Joseph who has existing paid licenses for several products. Because Customer Insights - Data unifies her company's external Purchase and Rewards data with Dataverse contact and lead data, the agent informs Sally that Joe is a valued Rewards and Loyalty points member, and it is able to provide other AI-generated insights such as the Customer Lifetime Value score, Churn Risk, and the segments Joe is a member of. Armed with a wealth of customer data, Sally is able to engage Joe and upsell Joe on their new product. Business Value: Agents give your marketing, sales, and service teams essential insights and can automate many business processes. But agents are only as good as the data they work with. When you give them access to customer insights that unify your customer data sources, you can get more valuable and actionable insights that enable organizational efficiencies that you couldn't achieve before. Now, more insights generated by Customer Insights - Data can be leveraged from within Microsoft Copilot Studio, allowing you to turn insights into a powerful business asset. Copilot Studio, and even your own custom copilots created in Microsoft Copilot Studio, can now simply and easily get access to more insights, allowing agents to understand, share, analyze, and act on these insights. Every team member gets tailored information and tools to reach their goals efficiently. Enabled for: Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Copilot and AI innovation - View next best actions with Customer Intent Agent
items.description: An administrator can enable this feature for the entire organization in the Customer Service admin center. Turning on next best actions populates the Copilot pane with actions that service representatives can use. Important case attributes are consolidated in one place as the representative gathers information through back-and-forth exchanges with the customer. Knowledge articles are suggested so representatives can dig deeper and understand the reasoning behind the recommendations. Business Value: Next Best Action (NBA) allows service representatives to perform a suite of Copilot-powered actions in one click. These actions include, but aren't limited to, drafting emails, updating knowledge articles, updating case notes, and more. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Administrator experiences - Use enhanced customer-first direct callbacks
items.description: Customer-first direct callback introduces a configurable, AI-powered experience managed through "callback profiles" in the Copilot Service admin center. Administrators define a callback profile—including greeting message, alternate number capture, callback offering window, retry logic, and AI agent selection—and associate it with queues under overflow handling. For each queue where direct callback is chosen as an overflow action, the administrator also must select a callback profile to ensure a customized callback experience for the queue. Business Value: Customer-first direct callback gives you a smarter way to manage customer calls. Instead of making customers wait on hold, the system initiates a callback the moment they reach the front of the line, so that they never lose their place. A prebuilt AI agent captures callback details. You can use your own AI agent to run custom workflows like customer verification. Your representatives join the call only when the customer is ready, saving time, reducing missed calls, and boosting productivity. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Copilot and AI innovation - Analyze demand using generative insights for better planning
items.description: Generative insights for Demand planning in Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management help you analyze sales history and forecast data across dimensions like product and location. With general availability, generative insights now include a new metric: trends . The system dynamically clusters data based on detected patterns, such as high trending , medium trending , relative flat , and declining trend . You can view aggregated values by selected dimensions or drill down into detailed values for each planning object. Business Value: Generative insights in Demand planning help you identify patterns like seasonality, trends, and signal correlations to improve forecast accuracy. By clustering data dynamically, you can make better decisions, optimize inventory, and reduce costs from overstocking or stockouts. These insights help you meet customer demand, improve service levels, and gain a competitive edge. Enabled for: Enabled for end users automatically

items.title: Microsoft Dataverse: Enable AI powered business workflows in Work IQ with Dataverse - Build Dataverse solutions with coding agents using Dataverse skills
items.description: Build Dataverse solutions by using coding agents with natural language prompts. For example, "I'm building a recruiting system for Zava Construction. I need tables for Positions, Candidates, Interviewers, Interviews, and Feedback - with lookups, a many-to-many relationship between Candidates and Positions, and a self-referential interview chain. Create everything in a Zava Recruiting solution, load sample data, and show me which candidates are currently interviewing." From this prompt, the agent autonomously: Discovers your Dataverse environment and configures MCP. Creates the solution by using the Microsoft Power Platform CLI. Builds five tables with choice columns, lookups, and a many-to-many relationship. Generates and runs a Python script to bulk-load realistic sample data. Queries across tables to answer your business question. No skill names. No tool flags. No context switching between docs, CLI, and scripts. The agent handles the orchestration end-to-end. Business Value: By using coding agents, you can eliminate the need to manually create Microsoft Dataverse tables and solutions through the UI. Dataverse skills guide coding agents to connect to your environment and build solutions by using tables, relationships, forms, and views. This process also includes creating sample data. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Power Pages: Power Pages Copilot - Use Power Pages MCP server capabilities
items.description: Power Pages MCP server enables makers to expose site data and operations through a secure, standardized interface compatible with AI clients. In the public preview release, makers can enable Create, Read, Update, Delete (CRUD) operations via the site’s Web API layer without writing custom code. Makers can provision the MCP server endpoint through site settings, allowing customers to securely interact with site data or perform operations using natural language queries through popular AI chat clients. Business Value: Power Pages MCP server empowers you to transform site data and operations into structured tools for AI assistants, enabling natural language interactions for updates and queries. This means faster workflows, less manual effort, and improved user experiences, helping your teams save time and stay productive. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Administrator experiences - Manage users through Microsoft Entra security groups
items.description: Administrators configure team-based access for representatives through Microsoft Entra ID security groups. They link an Entra security group to a Dataverse team of type Microsoft Entra ID Security Group and assign at the team level the required security roles such as: Basic user Customer Service Representative Omnichannel agent Every member of the linked group inherits the roles automatically with no per user role assignment, including: Queue participation Presence Conversation handling When a representative belongs to more than one team, they receive the combined privileges of their teams. Existing persona-based assignments continue to work, so current configurations continue to function without changes. Business Value: Large contact centers face major challenges when they onboard and offboard service representatives at scale. Administrators must assign multiple security roles to each user individually. This approach increases effort, delays readiness, and raises the risk of access errors. This feature simplifies access management through Microsoft Entra security groups. Administrators assign roles to a group once. They grant or revoke access instantly by adding or removing users from the groups. Organizations reduce administrative burden, strengthen access control, and speed up onboarding. New service representatives receive the access they need on day one. Administrators replace thousands of repetitive tasks with a centralized, scalable model that supports growth and improves operational efficiency. Enabled for: Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

items.title: Power Pages: Design studio - Configure authentication with security agent
items.description: The security agent is available directly within the security workspace in Power Pages design studio. Makers can open the security agent tab to access the embedded chat panel and security tools. From there, they can interact using natural language to review risks, understand configurations, and take guided actions. The agent assists with both authentication and authorization setup. It guides makers through configuring identity providers, reviewing authentication settings, and strengthening login protections. Based on the site’s setup, it can recommend improvements such as securing token configurations, validating redirect settings, or tightening session-related controls. For authorization, the security agent helps configure web roles and data access permissions. Using the site’s data schema and usage patterns, it suggests appropriate access levels, such as read-only, owner-only, or full administrative control aligned with least privilege best practices. All suggested changes require explicit user approval before being applied. After execution, the agent confirms what was updated, ensuring full transparency and control. By combining guided setup, continuous review, and contextual recommendations, the security agent helps keep Power Pages sites secure from initial configuration through ongoing maintenance. Business Value: Security agent empowers makers to set up secure access controls without needing deep security expertise. It uses AI to recommend the right roles and permissions for your data tables. It continuously monitors your site for misconfigurations, helping you reduce risk, ensure compliance, and build customer trust. Enabled for: Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Administrator experiences - Use Service Operations Agent to accelerate setup, onboard, and verify config changes
items.description: Service Operations Agent in the Copilot Service admin center delivers a unified, conversational experience for configuring Dynamics 365 Contact Center. Administrators use conversational setup and orchestration in Service Operations Agent to streamline setup tasks—configure channels, voice settings, Teams Phone extensibility, and knowledge sources. Through the same single guided assistant, administrators also set up route-to-queue rules and assignment strategies for queues and AI agents—automating and optimizing queue management and agent assignments to drive operational efficiency. With Service Operations Agent, admins can: Generate and validate configurations in real time. Surface diagnostics and actionable insights. Receive clear explanations for recommendations and setup choices. By consolidating fragmented configuration workflows, Service Operations Agent reduces errors, shortens deployment timelines, and simplifies onboarding for customers and partners. Business Value: Service Operations Agent is an AI-powered assistant that empowers admins to simplify configuration, speed up onboarding, and ensure continuous validation of changes. By leveraging conversational setup and intelligent automation, the agent eliminates manual complexity, enabling faster deployments, reducing errors, and providing real-time feedback on every change. Designed for enterprise-scale reliability, Service Operations Agent supports seamless transitions, proactive monitoring, and compliance-ready operations. Enabled for: Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Optimize resource scheduling - Optimize schedules with Scheduling Operations Agent
items.description: Dispatchers often spend considerable time and energy reviewing and adjusting each technician's schedule as conditions change throughout the workday: A technician has one or more cancellations in the afternoon. To fill the open slots, what requirements optimally keep promise windows, prefer high-priority work, and locate work around the same neighborhoods that the technician is due to travel to? A technician is running over the planned time for the current booking. As a result, they're late for the next booking, and the delay might cascade to subsequent bookings. How do you best adjust the bookings for the remainder of the day? A technician recovers from illness sooner than expected and is now available for work earlier than planned. What's the best way to schedule work for them when they return? A technician’s schedule contains a lot of low-priority work that isn't due for weeks. How can you improve the schedule with work that better meets desired business goals? A technician’s schedule for the day is built manually or with the schedule assistant. How can you rearrange the schedule so that the resource’s travel time is reduced? In each case, the dispatcher needs to assess the situation, determine which business goals apply, and then update the schedule manually, one booking at a time. With this release of the Scheduling Operations Agent, dispatchers can ask Copilot to provide the best schedule for the affected technician. Within seconds, the dispatcher gets a suggested schedule for review and can apply the updates. You can direct Copilot to optimize for the business goal you want, such as maximizing technician usage or work order priority. Copilot intelligently chooses among existing bookings and new unfulfilled work orders based on factors like skillset match, territories, and customer promise windows. Users can access the feature from the Copilot side pane anywhere within the Dynamics 365 Field Service application. Business Value: The Scheduling Operations Agent for Dynamics 365 Field Service enables dispatchers to quickly and easily optimize schedules for technicians as conditions change throughout the workday, so they can significantly improve their productivity. Dispatchers can ask Copilot to optimize schedules and address issues such as traffic delays, double bookings, or last-minute cancellations that often result in conflicts, gaps, or idle time in a technician's schedule. Instruct Copilot to achieve the desired business objective, such as maximizing technician usage or work order priority while considering factors like skillset match, territories, and promised time windows. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Workforce engagement management - Automate shift rotations for consistent workforce coverage
items.description: What the feature does Shift rotation policies help organizations distribute customer service representatives across recurring shifts on a configurable schedule. Supervisors can create rotation policies that define how representatives move between time slots over time and apply those policies to shift plans. Supervisors create policies by specifying a start date, time zone, rotation cadence, and a set of recurring time slots. Representatives are assigned to each time slot, and the scheduler automatically applies the rotation pattern when generating future schedules. This reduces the need for manual shift reassignment while supporting consistent workforce coverage across operating hours. Changes to a policy affect only future scheduling runs. Existing bookings remain unchanged. When additional staffing is needed, the scheduler can use available flexible workers or other eligible representatives who can cover the required time period. How the feature is enabled Administrators enable Workforce Management and shift scheduling capabilities in Customer Service. Supervisors then create and manage shift rotation policies, assign representatives to rotation groups, and associate policies with shift plans. After a policy is assigned to a shift plan, future automatic scheduling runs apply the configured rotation pattern. Supervisors can pause a policy or remove it from a shift plan at any time to stop rotation-based scheduling. Business Value: Organizations that operate 24/7 contact centers or use rotating shifts can reduce the time supervisors spend manually reassigning agents to schedules. With shift rotation policies, administrators define the rotation pattern once and the scheduler automatically applies it. This helps ensure fair and predictable shift distribution for customer service representatives, reduces administrative overhead for supervisors, and supports consistent staffing coverage across operating hours. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Orchestrate conversation distribution with natural language playbooks
items.description: Conversation orchestration in Dynamics 365 Contact Center keeps every conversation actively managed throughout its lifecycle, from initiation through resolution. Instead of applying fixed rules at different stages of a conversation journey, conversation orchestration monitors each conversation as conditions evolve, like wait time increases, fast-filling queues, or service representatives going offline, and responds automatically with the right action. For example, administrators can define the intent using natural-language playbooks as follows: "If a premium customer waits for more than three minutes and no senior agents are available, increase their priority and offer a callback." Conversation orchestration then handles how it's run in real time. You can configure playbooks per scenario through guided templates that keep instructions focused and reliable. Built-in validation catches conflicts before anything goes live, so that you confidently publish changes without needing to test every edge case manually. The key capabilities are as follows: Dynamic priority escalation : In traditional systems, conversation priority is typically set once, at entry, and never revisited. This means a customer who has been waiting for 10 minutes competes for the same expert as another customer who has just arrived, and a conversation that’s transferred mid-journey resets to whatever the new queue's default priority is. Dynamic priority escalation fixes this by continuously re-evaluating priority as the conversation progresses. You define the conditions such as wait time thresholds, queue transfers, customer tier, or other context and conversation orchestration adjusts priority automatically throughout the conversation lifecycle. High-value or long-waiting customers move forward without anyone watching the queue manually. Overflow handling across multiple conditions : Conversation orchestration supports a broader set of business triggered overflow conditions, allowing organizations to respond intelligently as queue conditions change. Administrators can define actions when a queue is outside operating hours, when all representatives in a queue are signed out or unavailable, when queue wait time exceeds a defined threshold, or when the number of waiting conversations surpasses a specified limit. Depending on the situation, orchestration can automatically offer callbacks, route conversations to alternate queues, expand assignment eligibility, notify supervisors, or deliver contextual customer messages. This ensures customers are never left waiting without a defined path forward. Admins can also configure overflow handling for direct inward dial calls now, when reps are not available or don't accept the calls. Assign to a previously engaged or preferred representative : Customers often need to repeat information when they are connected to a new representative for every interaction. Conversation orchestration helps maintain continuity by reconnecting customers with previously engaged or preferred representatives whenever possible. Assignment decisions take into account historical interactions, queue membership alignment, representative availability, and workload capacity. For asynchronous conversations, organizations can choose to honor representative presence status and active conversation limits before reconnecting customers, ensuring returning conversations are assigned only when the preferred representative has capacity to engage. When the preferred or previously engaged representative is unavailable, conversations seamlessly fall back to the next best qualified representative. This reduces customer effort, improves resolution efficiency, and delivers a more personalized support experience. Bullseye routing : Finding the right representative often requires balancing expertise with response times. Bullseye routing enables organizations to gradually expand the pool of eligible representatives when a conversation isn't assigned within a defined timeframe. Administrators can define progressive routing rings that begin with the most qualified representatives and then expand to broader groups based on skills, proficiency levels, teams, or other business criteria. This approach maximizes the likelihood of connecting customers with the best-qualified representative while ensuring conversations don't wait indefinitely for a specific resource. These capabilities are the first in a broad and growing set of orchestration scenarios that conversation orchestration will support across the full conversation lifecycle, spanning overflow management, priority handling, assignment strategies, in-conversation messaging, and escalation. Each new capability builds on the same natural-language playbook foundation, so organizations can adopt new scenarios without rebuilding what they have already configured. Business Value: Traditional automatic conversation distribution systems rely on complex rules and static configuration that are difficult to maintain and can't adapt as conditions change throughout the conversation lifecycle. Unified routing with its new AI-powered conversation orchestration uses the power of agentic AI to continuously monitor events throughout the entire conversation lifecycle and responds with the right action when required. This is a shift from a static system to an orchestration layer that remains active and intelligent from the moment a conversation arrives in a queue until it's resolved. The new feature reduces administrative complexity and helps deliver more flexible customer experiences at scale, even under fluctuating demand. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys: Create journeys in minutes with Journey Creation Agent
items.description: You simply describe in everyday words what you want to create and the Journey Creation Agent builds the journey for you. With Journey Creation Agent, you can: Use an AI-powered, guided experience for optimized outcomes. Build in minutes with no technical jargon, complex setup, or cold start. Use natural language to describe the journey you want to create. Drive results–the agent interprets your goal and asks relevant follow-up questions to refine your intent and ensure accuracy. Scenario A campaign manager wants to re-engage inactive customers but has no time to build a journey from scratch. The manager simply types, “Send a re-engagement email to customers who haven’t purchased in 90 days, follow up with a reminder with a discount.” The journey is instantly generated, with the right audience, content, and structure.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys: Improve engagement and message timing with Outreach Optimization Agent
items.description: Add the Outreach Optimization Agent to your journey, select the emails you want delivered, and let the agent handle timing and cadence automatically. With Outreach Optimization Agent, you can: Start with an intelligent baseline : Outreach Optimization Agent automatically creates a baseline messaging plan for your audience by analyzing overall historical engagement patterns, producing a smart, generic plan that is designed to work well for most customers before any individual optimization kicks in. Listen to incoming interactions and adapt the plan in real time : The agent continuously monitors incoming signals, including engagement and non-responsiveness, and adjusts follow-up timing and cadence, or exits the plan based on whether the goal is progressing or has been achieved. Respect quiet times : The agent enforces quiet time settings as a hard constraint, ensuring that messages are never sent outside approved communication windows, even if engagement data suggests otherwise. Scenario A global retail brand uses Outreach Optimization Agent in a seasonal campaign to re-engage customers. Unlike previous efforts with fixed schedules and repeated reminders, the agent creates a smart baseline plan, then adjusts message timing for each customer based on their engagement. It slows or stops follow-ups when customers show interest and spaces out reminders for unresponsive customers, all while respecting quiet times and consent. This leads to better engagement and less message fatigue, with minimal manual intervention.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Author Commerce receipt formats with Copilot Cowork
items.description: Use natural language in Copilot Cowork to create, update, translate, and check Commerce receipt layouts using existing formats in headquarters. The Commerce receipt format designer skill lets authorized users work with receipt layouts through natural-language requests in Copilot Cowork, using receipt configuration in Dynamics 365 Commerce headquarters. It applies to receipt formats used by Store Commerce point of sale (POS). Users can: Create and adapt formats: Start from an existing format in the modern Receipt designer representation, create a new format, or request changes to an existing target. Edit receipt sections: Modify header, line, and footer content, field positions, alignment, and supported formatting. Translate and personalize content: Translate static labels and add user-supplied text while preserving dynamic fields. Missing business details are identified rather than invented. Check layouts without changing them: Request structural or geometry checks that identify overlaps, width violations, and truncation risks, with findings and suggested remediation. Verify saved changes: Review the resulting format and changes, with saved configuration re-read to confirm the requested update. Creating a format from a source preserves that source. The skill is available automatically to authorized Copilot Cowork users. Users describe the source format and desired outcome, resolve any source or target ambiguity, and review the results. A Commerce administrator ensures appropriate headquarters access and that the source format is available in the modern structured representation. Structural checks do not establish visual appearance, barcode scanability, runtime values, or legal and fiscal compliance. Users review the layout in the Receipt designer and perform appropriate test printing before operational use. Assigning formats to receipt profiles or printers and printing or reprinting transactions are separate setup and operational workflows.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced Copilot and AI controls for meetings
items.description: Teams Meetings offer enhanced AI controls for Copilot and AI experiences. Organizers manage who can enable and access AI, while IT admins get a simpler policy model for governing AI across meetings and post-meeting experiences. These updates provide more predictable administration and greater flexibility for compliance and governance scenarios.

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Provide a Copilot starter prompt in Teams and LMS Assignments
items.description: Educators can provide a Copilot starter prompt from Student AI Guidelines in Teams and LMS Assignments. Students open Copilot with the educator's prompt ready in their chat, helping them begin with instructions tailored to the assignment.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Sales Development Agent - Meeting scheduling
items.description: Sales Development Agent can turn a prospect’s interest in meeting into a booked seller meeting. The agent asks the prospect to provide preferred dates and times, evaluates those options against the appropriate seller’s calendar, and books the first valid option in the prospect’s stated preference order. The seller and prospect receive the meeting invitation, while the seller receives additional conversation context to support a warm handoff. If scheduling cannot be completed, the agent transfers the request and relevant context to the seller for follow-up.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Enable semantic model in Sales agent
items.description: Semantic model helps Sales Agent understand the structure and meaning of an organization’s CRM data. It creates a connected representation of CRM metadata, including tables or objects, fields, descriptions, data types, relationships, views, pick-list values, and glossary terms. Sales Agent can retrieve this context when responding to questions, improving its ability to interpret business language and answer complex questions that span related CRM records. Dynamics 365 admins can enable and turn on semantic model in Power Apps Maker Portal and configure the data coverage and signals that Sales Agent should use. Admins can configure the underlying data, views, metadata and relationships used in the model. For Salesforce customers, the semantic model will be based on existing Sales agent table and glossary configuration in Sales agent settings or Power Apps Maker Portal. In Power Apps Maker Portal, Salesforce admins will can configure additional Salesforce signals to use in semantic model such as relationships and views.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference files saved in SharePoint libraries and OneDrive folders when creating a presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint
items.description: You can now reference files saved in SharePoint libraries and OneDrive folders when creating a presentation with Copilot using Agent Mode in PowerPoint.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference an email with Work IQ when using Edit with Copilot in PowerPoint to create a presentation
items.description: You can now reference an email with Work IQ when using Edit with Copilot in PowerPoint to create a presentation.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Sales Development Agent is now available

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Use Expense Manager role center
items.description: The Expense Manager Role Center is updated to provide a more focused and efficient experience for managing vendor and expense-related activities. The enhancements align the workspace with typical expense management workflows, ensuring that key information and actions are readily accessible. Where relevant, other Role Centers are also updated to include access to expense management features.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Add an interim approver when you submit an expense report
items.description: This feature introduces support for a simple interim approval scenario for expense reports. When someone submits an expense report, organizations can designate an interim approver to review and approve expenses before the final approver can review and approve. Interim approver must review expense reports to confirm whether they're complete and compliant before final approver.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Create expense reports per trip automatically
items.description: Expense Agent can automatically create expense reports based on identified business trips. You just need to configure the feature on the Expense Agent Setup page. Instead of manually collecting and organizing individual expense entries, you can use the agent to group relevant expenses and generate a dedicated expense report for each trip. Key capabilities include: Administrators can specify whether the company wants to group expenses by trip and not only by period. Automated expense report creation without requiring you to manually start and organize reports after a travel requisition is approved. Automatic trip-based expense grouping associates eligible expenses with the correct business trip based on information in the travel requisition. The agent automatically groups not only expenses based on the location, but uses intelligence to group all expenses based on the context. Non-trip related expenses keep existing period-based grouping in expense reports.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Ability for IT admins to customize the user notification messages for recording and transcription in calls
items.description: This feature enables IT admins to customize a portion of the user notification messages for recording and transcription during Teams calls.

items.title: Planner: Capabilities in Microsoft Cowork
items.description: You’ll soon be able to bring your Microsoft Planner into Microsoft Cowork. In Cowork, you can view, create, and update your plans, buckets, goals, and tasks without switching apps. Cowork goes a step further by helping you execute your Planner tasks across Microsoft 365, such as drafting and sending emails, scheduling meetings, posting updates to Teams, and working with files. It can then write progress back to Planner with your approval. You can move from planning your work to getting it done in one place.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Windows
items.description: In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Windows. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected. Rest assured no data remains in the room. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

items.title: Microsoft Dataverse: Enable semantic data understanding for agentic use
items.description: Give AI agents and Copilot a true understanding of your business data — not just raw schema — so they can answer questions accurately with less manual configuration. Learns from the systems you already run — Automatically extracts semantic knowledge from views, forms, and metadata already defined in your Dataverse environment, reducing agent deployment from days of manual setup to near-zero effort. Full visibility for makers — View generated semantic knowledge per entity — including name, description, and sample questions — directly in the Power Apps maker portal. Search for understanding gaps and enrich missing context with a built-in glossary for domain-specific terms. Governance and privacy built in — Enable or disable semantic signals at the org level, or at the individual signal-type or table level, giving makers and admins granular control to meet compliance and privacy requirements without sacrificing agent quality. No manual schema mapping. No custom query logic. No disambiguation between what your data is called and what your business actually means.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Manage intraday operations with AI agent
items.description: Intraday Agent is an autonomous AI agent that helps manage intraday operational scenarios. The following are its high-level capabilities. Intraday queue tracking Continuously monitors queue volumes in real time. Detects anomalies when actual volume deviates significantly from forecasted demand. Automatically reforecasts in real time to assess current demand. Notifies supervisors with proactive alerts and recommendations. Automates corrective actions such as adjusting schedules, rescheduling breaks, or reallocating service representatives to maintain SLA performance. Supports customizable instructions to align mitigation actions with business needs. Intraday adherence tracking Monitors service representative adherence to scheduled shift activities in real time. Detects deviations such as late logins, extended breaks, or early logouts. Autonomously mitigates deviations through actions such as break rescheduling, shift extensions, overtime activation, or flexible channel reassignment. Supports customizable instructions to align mitigation actions with business needs.

items.title: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration: Multi-grader comparison
items.description: Multi-grader comparison enables makers to compare the results of multiple graders applied to the same evaluation. The experience highlights agreement, differences, and overall grading behavior. Core capabilities The core capabilities include: Compare graders side-by-side. Compare scores. Review explanations from each grader. Analyze grading consistency. Results experience Results include: Comparative score view. Pass / fail comparison. Grader explanations. Evidence supporting each evaluation.
products: Microsoft Power Platform governance and administration

items.title: Word: Legal plugins in Copilot
items.description: Legal plugins in Copilot provide purpose-built skills to help legal professionals summarize, draft, review, and redline legal documents. Available in Word and Cowork, these plugins can use work context from Microsoft 365 and connect to supported third-party legal sources.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Export metrics from Agent Dashboard
items.description: Users can export de-identified, row-level agent metrics and attributes from the Agent Dashboard. Exported data provides detailed insights into agent usage and user-level agent interactions across the organization, with personal identifiers removed. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Reference files saved in SharePoint libraries and OneDrive folders when creating a presentation with Agent Mode in PowerPoint
items.description: You can now reference files saved in SharePoint libraries and OneDrive folders when creating a presentation with Copilot using Agent Mode in PowerPoint.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Support permission sync missed in incremental crawl
items.description: Earlier, permissions were synced only in the periodic full crawl which generally ha a default frequency of 1 day for most of the connectors. Now, we have support for doing permission syncs more frequently in an incremental way.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Enhanced Microsoft Copilot in Viva Engage
items.description: Introducing the Enhanced Microsoft 365 Copilot Experience in Viva Engage! Powered by Engage MCP, this enhanced experience takes Copilot in Engage beyond catch-ups and summaries, helping users explore conversations more deeply, synthesize discussions, and uncover meaningful insights. It's also more deeply connected across Microsoft 365. For example, you can ask Copilot to analyze feedback on a leader's post, identify key themes, and turn those insights into a reusable PowerPoint deck. With Work IQ integration, Copilot also has a better understanding of you and your work context, connecting conversations in Engage to your broader work across Microsoft 365. Engage MCP expands both the breadth and depth of Engage scenarios Copilot can support, making it more useful for understanding conversations and insights across your Engage network. This update also brings Copilot in Engage closer to the broader Microsoft 365 Copilot experience, with your Microsoft 365 agents now accessible directly within Copilot in Engage.

items.title: Copilot Studio: Computer Use for web browsing on GitHub Copilot Harness
items.description: Enable Microsoft Copilot Studio agents to browse and interact with websites as a native capability powered by the GitHub Copilot Harness. Using natural-language instructions, agents can navigate web pages, extract information, and download files. Agents can then use that information and those files alongside other tools to complete end-to-end workflows, extending their reach beyond configured knowledge sources and API-based integrations.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Support for sensitive documents protected with Microsoft Purview Information Protection (MPIP)
items.description: Unblock users from upload files with Microsoft Purview Information Protection (MPIP) sensitivity labels to Copilot Studio agents deployed on the M365 channel. With this support agents can process content based on the user's/agents account permissions, with label protections enforced end-to-end.

items.title: Work IQ: Human in the loop
items.description: Allow agents and agent flows to pause for human input or approval before continuing.

items.title: Work IQ: Agent Policy Governance
items.description: Provide administrators with policy-based controls for governing agents and their capabilities at scale.

items.title: Work IQ: Real Time Transcripts
items.description: Enable applications and agents to access Microsoft Teams meeting transcripts in real time for assistance and insights.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention for Microsoft Cowork
items.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention (DLP) is expanding to Microsoft Cowork, enabling data security admins to use a single policy across Microsoft 365 Copilot and Cowork. The integration helps protect sensitive AI interactions by preventing the use of labeled knowledge sources, blocking prompts that contain supported sensitive information types, and restricting sensitive prompts from being sent to Bing for web search.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting Shared Files
items.description: The new Meeting Shared Files feature allows users to add relevant files and links to their meeting for easy access and to automatically share that content with all meeting participants. AI in the meeting, like the Facilitator agent, uses these files for targeted grounding to answer questions and enhance skill functionality.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Session and Response Sharing in M365 Copilot
items.description: Session and Response Sharing let Microsoft 365 Copilot users share Copilot chat content through a link. Session Sharing shares a full chat session, while Response Sharing shares a single Copilot response. The shared content opens as a read-only view, and recipients can continue from it in their own Copilot chat. This gives Copilot users an easier and more controlled way to share useful Copilot outputs with coworkers instead of copying and pasting. It helps teams reuse work, share context, and collaborate more efficiently while keeping sharing within organizational controls.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit your document with Copilot in PowerPoint in Government Clouds
items.description: Copilot in PowerPoint helps you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural language—right inside your deck. Start a new presentation or build on an existing one by asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design, all while preserving your formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot can also connect to your brand kit to apply branded templates, insert brand-approved images, and check for brand compliance. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premium) users.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive SharePoint files under retention policies
items.description: With the introduction of file archiving support in SharePoint Online, administrators are looking to seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins want to now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle in SPO. Retention based file archiving moves inactive content to low-cost storage, lowering costs with no compromise on Compliance, keeping data discoverable and making Copilot results highly relevant.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Agent metrics for custom reporting in Insights analyst workbench
items.description: Unlock deeper insights into Copilot agent adoption with flexible, self-serve analytics. Insights global and partition analysts can access and combine granular agent usage metrics with agent and organizational attributes to uncover agent adoption trends, export and customize reporting, and drive more informed decisions, without relying on predefined dashboards.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot in PowerPoint for Government clouds
items.description: Copilot in PowerPoint lets you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural conversation, directly in your presentation. You can start a new presentation or build on an existing one, asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design—while preserving formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot uses your files, meetings, emails, and more to help shape content and iterate quickly, and it connects to your brand kit so you can apply branded templates, insert brand approved images, and check for brand compliance. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot–licensed users.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit with Copilot in Excel (Web, Win32, Mac) - GCC
items.description: Edit with Copilot lets you build and edit workbooks side by side with Copilot. When you're updating budgets, creating financial models, or analyzing data, Copilot uses Excel's most powerful tools like tables, charts, PivotTables, and formulas to help you get the job done.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Compliance Manager-Purview Compliance Manager integration with Microsoft Foundry for automated mapping of AI regulations and evaluation of Compliance controls for Foundry Agents
items.description: This feature in Purview Compliance Manager shall enable customers to automatically access the compliance posture of Agents created in AI Foundry. Customers can map Agents being created in AI Foundry to compliance regulations and assessments in Purview Compliance Manager and get to know the compliance status and improvement actions to be innovative and compliant.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Purview SDK embedded in Agent Framework SDK
items.description: Purview SDK embedded in Agent Framework SDK enables developers to seamlessly integrate enterprise-grade security, compliance, and governance into the AI agents they build. This integration enables automatic classification and protection of sensitive data, prevents data leaks and oversharing, and provides visibility and control for regulatory compliance—empowering organizations to confidently and securely adopt AI agents in complex environments.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Simplified device settings for voice and face recognition on Teams Rooms on Android
items.description: It's easier for admins to enable the benefits of intelligent audio and video and Copilot for users in Teams Rooms through a new user interface and admin settings. These new settings, on the device and in the Pro Management portal, simplify configuration and remove the requirement to use PowerShell, offering improved visibility across rooms.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Copilot Analytics - Agent 365 reporting availability for Microsoft platform agents
items.description: Customers can now view agent insights in the Agent 365 Dashboard in Microsoft Viva Insights (Copilot Analytics) without an Agent 365 license. Customers will be able to view reporting on their Microsoft platform-built agents in one consolidated picture, along with context on who built each agent and why.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Auto-open Copilot side pane for Outlook links
items.description: When users open links from Outlook, Microsoft Edge can automatically open the Copilot side pane to provide contextual insights and actionable suggestion chips based on email and destination content - such as highlighting key points, and recommending next actions - without disrupting the browsing flow. This experience helps users quickly understand content, take action with fewer steps, and get more value from Copilot while extending productive browsing time in Edge. Admins can control availability to this feature using the M365LinksAutoOpenCopilotEnabled policy.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Usage reports – Microsoft 365 Copilot Connectors
items.description: A new usage report will be available in the Microsoft 365 admin center for Copilot Connectors in Microsoft 365 Copilot, designed to give organizations a detailed view of how connectors are being used within Microsoft 365 Copilot. This report provides insights into overall connector activity, and connector powered response patterns over time, along with detailed user-level connectors adoption data. With these analytics, admins can monitor adoption, identify usage patterns, and optimize Copilot experiences to drive greater value across their organization. #copilotcontrolsystem

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Optimize resource scheduling - Optimize multiple resources with Scheduling Operations Agent
items.description: This release expands the optimization capabilities of the Scheduling Operations Agent to include multiple resources. The agent considers the availability of the resources, their current schedules, and unscheduled requirements. It suggests a schedule that honors configured constraints and optimizes it according to the selected goal. Dispatchers can review and compare the proposed schedules with the current schedules before applying changes. New capabilities include: Optimize schedules for up to 5 resources directly from the schedule board. Optimize schedules for up to 30 resources using an optimization plan. Create custom goals and weight objectives. Create custom optimization scopes to use with your optimization plans. These capabilities build on the existing public preview of the Scheduling Operations Agent and will be automatically enabled for all organizations that have the agent enabled. Learn more at Scheduling Operations Agent documentation . Business Value: Optimize multiple resources with the Scheduling Operations Agent (SOA). Schedule up to five resources directly from the schedule board or Copilot or perform ad-hoc optimizations for up to 30 resources using an optimization plan. This feature streamlines scheduling, improves efficiency, and supports better resource management. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Microsoft Dataverse: Build your low code hyperscale backend on Dataverse - Build your agentic flows with Dataverse SDK for Python
items.description: The Microsoft Dataverse SDK for Python empowers data scientists and developers to build intelligent, compliant, and scalable agentic flows that integrate seamlessly with Dataverse. In the agentic age, where autonomous agents orchestrate workflows and act on behalf of users, the SDK provides the essential tools to interact programmatically with enterprise data platforms. The SDK supports structured data access, composable APIs, and governance features that are critical for building trustworthy and efficient agents. Key capabilities can include: Autonomous data agents that can query, update, and evaluate data quality Form prediction and autofill Support for agentic primitives like Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) collaboration The SDK for Python offers a streamlined developer experience with support for common Create, Retrieve, Update, and Delete (CRUD) operations, bulk data processing, metadata access, and observability tools. SDK Python packages are to be published on PyPI.org with open-source support. The SDK is strategically positioned to enable agent-native development with semantic modeling, secure impersonation, and compliance built-in. Business Value: Enables data scientists and developers to create, access, and manage Dataverse business data using Python programming. The Dataverse SDK for Python implements common Python programming paradigms and best practices, provides a more natural Python interface to Dataverse, and supports community contributions. Enabled for: Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Service representative experiences - Use pinned contacts and queues during consult and transfer
items.description: In the Copilot Service admin center, administrators configure and manage pinned contacts and queues for representatives as follows: Enable pins in the Customer settings > Manage pins > Admin pins page so that representatives pin their contacts and queues. Pin specific contacts and queues for representatives. Display pinned items to representatives based on business units. Business Value: This feature streamlines your team’s workflow by removing the hassle of tracking multiple consult and transfer targets, so that your service representatives focus on delivering faster, more reliable support. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Reporting and data analysis - Use new APIs for analyzing approval workflows for auditors and IT staff
items.description: In this release wave, we're introducing read-only APIs on the (workflow) approval system. This allows for establishing security and auditing analytics and reporting outside Business Central—for example, creating reports with Power BI or agents with Microsoft Copilot Studio and MCP Server for Business Central. The APIs are read-only and allow querying for: Workflow Workflow and User mappings Workflow, User, and Action history We're also introducing a new permission set that allows a user to use approval APIs. This shouldn't be granted to standard users, but might be included in security-related permission sets. Business Value: This feature enhances transparency and control by enabling secure, read-only access to approval workflows and user actions. Businesses can leverage these APIs to build advanced auditing and compliance reports in tools like Power BI, ensuring stronger governance and accountability. Additionally, integration with Microsoft Copilot Studio and MCP Server opens opportunities for intelligent automation and analytics, driving efficiency and insight. By isolating permissions for API access, organizations maintain robust security while empowering authorized teams to innovate confidently. Enabled for: Enabled for end users automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Filter the adherence tracker by planning group
items.description: This feature provides the following capabilities: The adherence tracker includes a planning group filter that supervisors can use to scope the view to a specific planning group. The planning group filter works with the existing shift plan and service representative filters, so supervisors can combine filters to refine a single view. The tracker displays representatives based on the planning groups associated with their scheduled shifts. This behavior keeps the tracker aligned with the shift plan used to calculate adherence. The tracker saves each supervisor’s filter selections across sessions and opens with their previous scope. The tracker recalculates adherence percentages and out-of-adherence counts for the filtered scope, providing a planning group-level view of intraday adherence. In Copilot Service workspace, go to Workforce management > Adherence tracker . Access and prerequisites To use Workforce Management capabilities, an administrator must install the Workforce Management for Customer Service package from the Power Platform admin center. Business Value: Supervising large contact centers is tough when you have to scan endless lists to find your team. Now, with planning group support, you can filter the adherence tracker to just the groups you manage. That means you spot issues faster and act right away, keeping service levels on track in real time instead of fixing problems after the fact. This feature scales for enterprise operations with hundreds of representatives and aligns with the same planning group structure you already use for forecasting, staffing, and scheduling. It saves time, reduces complexity, and helps you stay focused on what matters most: delivering consistent service. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Filter adherence historical analytics by planning group
items.description: This feature provides the following capabilities: The adherence historical analytics report includes a planning group filter that workforce managers can use to scope results to one or more planning groups. The planning group filter works with the report’s existing filters, allowing managers to combine planning groups, date ranges, and other report parameters in a single view. The report recalculates adherence metrics for the filtered scope, providing a group-level view of adherence performance instead of a contact center-wide aggregate. The report associates representatives with planning groups through their scheduled shifts. This behavior keeps historical reporting aligned with the shift plans used to calculate adherence. Planning groups must be configured and have assigned representatives before the filter returns results. In Copilot Service workspace, go to Workforce management . Access and prerequisites To use Workforce Management capabilities, an administrator must install the Workforce Management for Customer Service package from the Power Platform admin center. Business Value: Adherence only matters when it reflects how your work is organized. Until now, historical adherence reports didn’t account for planning groups, making it hard to see if performance dips came from a single under-supported queue or were spread across the operation. With planning group support, you can focus your analysis on the groups that matter and compare adherence across them for the same time period. This gives you clearer insights and helps you make smarter staffing decisions. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Workforce engagement management - Associate forecast scenarios with planning groups
items.description: This feature provides the following capabilities: When creating or editing a forecast scenario, forecasters can optionally select a planning group. When a planning group is selected, the Timezone , Channel , and Queue values are populated from the planning group definition and become read-only. This behavior keeps the scenario aligned with its planning group. When no planning group is selected, forecasters can manually edit the Timezone , Channel , and Queue values. Existing scenario creation workflows remain unchanged. The forecast scenario list includes a Planning group column that forecasters can use to sort and filter scenarios. Capacity plans created from a forecast scenario inherit the scenario’s planning group. For a capacity plan created from an uploaded file, forecasters can select the planning group manually. Access and prerequisites To use Workforce Management capabilities, an administrator must install the Workforce Management for Customer Service package from the Power Platform admin center. Business Value: Contact center demand rarely aligns perfectly with a single queue. Most lines of business, sites, or skill pools rely on multiple queues and channels that share the same agents and service goals. Planning group support brings these queues and channels together so you can forecast them as one unit. Instead of juggling separate scenarios, you work with a single view where volume and average handle time reflect the actual demand pool your team staffs. This means you can pass accurate numbers straight to capacity planning and scheduling without extra steps. You save time, reduce errors, and measure performance at the level your business truly operates. If you manage dozens of queues across multiple lines of business, this feature shifts forecasting from a queue-by-queue task to planning at the scale of your entire operation. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Copilot and AI innovation - Use Copilot Cowork to orchestrate insights and actions for representatives
items.description: The plugin in Copilot Cowork is available out of the box for service representatives. They can use the Customer Service skills after the administrator enables the plugin for them in Cowork settings. The key capabilities are as follows: Prioritizes and enriches cases : Surfaces highest-attention cases with suggested next actions. Reviews for criticality and severity : Flags cases where severity mismatches actual urgency signals. Briefs case at intake : One-screen customer, history, prior cases, and SLA snapshot. Summarizes root cause and resolution : Proposes likely cause and ranked next-step resolutions. Matches knowledge articles : Matches top articles, flags gaps, updates stale content. Drafts replies : Generates template-based customer email replies for CSR review. Handles escalations and handoffs : Detects triggers and assembles escalation packet for next owner. Business Value: The Customer Service plugin in Copilot Cowork helps service teams boost productivity at scale by offloading complex, multi-step case workflows. It ensures every action is grounded in the right Dynamics 365 environment and enriched with Microsoft 365 context, eliminating manual lookup. The custom skills allow teams to tailor Cowork to their workflows, knowledge sources, and triage rules for more precise assistance. The built-in checkpoints provide human-in-the-loop governance, ensuring accuracy, compliance, and trust before any changes are committed. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Copilot and AI innovation - Use Dynamics 365 Sales skills in Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork
items.description: As an admin, you can control who can access Copilot Cowork in your organization. The Dynamics 365 Sales plugin is installed by default in Copilot Cowork and available to all users who have access to Cowork. As a seller, you can use the sales skills in Copilot Cowork to: Understand customer, opportunity, and pipeline context without manually gathering information from multiple systems. Identify changes, risks, engagement patterns, and areas that require attention. Prioritize work across customers, opportunities, leads, and pipeline activities. Generate recommendations and next-best actions based on available business context. Analyze business performance, pipeline health, and sales execution trends. Support decision-making across individual, team, and organizational sales workflows. Business Value: If you spend the day moving between CRM, email, meetings, calendars, and collaboration tools, Dynamics 365 Sales skills bring that context together in Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork. By grounding Cowork in Dynamics 365 Sales data and Microsoft 365 signals, you get more relevant insights, recommendations, and actions in the flow of work. This helps you quickly understand customer relationships, opportunity health, pipeline changes, and next steps, so you spend less time gathering information and more time moving deals forward. By combining customer, opportunity, account, lead, activity, and pipeline information with emails, meetings, calendars, and collaboration signals, Cowork can help users understand what has changed, identify what requires attention, and determine appropriate next actions. Enabled for: Enabled for end users automatically

items.title: Microsoft Dataverse: Activate Enterprise Data in Copilot - Create Dataverse agent users with Microsoft Entra agent identity
items.description: Organizations can securely deploy AI agents to access and interact with Dataverse data by using enterprise-managed Microsoft Entra agent identities. This feature enables agents to be provisioned as Dataverse agent users with dedicated, least-privileged security roles based on their intended capabilities. This feature ensures agents have only the access required to perform tasks autonomously or on behalf of users. By using identity-based role assignment and full auditing of agent-driven actions, organizations can enforce security and compliance policies across both human users and AI agents while maintaining traceability of data access and changes within Dataverse environments. Business Value: This feature enables secure, compliant management of AI agents in Microsoft Dataverse, which reduces risk and improves governance for autonomous and interactive agents. Enabled for: Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Supervisor experiences - Provide real-time coaching with Quality Assurance Agent
items.description: The quality evaluation skill of the Quality Assurance Agent now includes real-time coaching, enabling organizations to shift from post-interaction monitoring to in-the-moment guidance during live conversations. Service representatives receive contextual coaching nudges during live conversations based on configured quality criteria and guardrails, allowing immediate course correction and improved interaction quality. Organizations can: Define policy-driven coaching triggers : Configure which quality criteria (such as compliance, empathy, script adherence, or resolution steps) initiate real-time coaching. Provide contextual, conversation-aware nudges : Deliver coaching suggestions based on the live conversation to ensure relevance. Control coaching triggers : Specify when coaching is triggered, such as for missed behaviors, risk signals, or guideline violations. Manage coaching frequency : Set frequency limits and suppression rules to prevent over-intervention. Enforce boundaries for sensitive scenarios : Apply stricter or mandatory guidance for cases such as compliance requirements or escalations. Business Value: Shift your quality assurance approach from passive evaluation to real-time coaching that makes an immediate difference in customer interactions. With enhanced real-time guidance, you can move beyond monitoring and give your team the support they need to adjust on the spot, improve conversations, and maintain quality and compliance every time. Enabled for: Enabled for admins/makers/marketers automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Reporting and data analysis - Use new APIs for analyzing permissions for auditors and IT staff

With seamless integration into tools like Power BI and Microsoft Copilot Studio, organizations can create advanced reports and intelligent agents for deeper insights. This capability enhances transparency, supports regulatory requirements, and accelerates decision-making by providing secure, real-time access to permission data. Ultimately, it helps businesses maintain robust governance while unlocking new opportunities for automation and analytics. Enabled for: Enabled for end users automatically

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance and Operations cross-app: Boost productivity with Copilot - Use Copilot Cowork to orchestrate insights and actions across Dynamics 365 ERP
items.description: The Copilot Cowork plugin for finance and operations apps enables users to move from business intent to insight to execution in a single experience. Reduce manual coordination, accelerate decision-making, improve workflow consistency, and shift user time from information gathering to applying business judgment. items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Unified routing - Use pick-based assignment method for work items
items.description: Use the No auto assignment method for queues in Copilot Service admin center when you want routed conversations to remain unassigned after they enter a queue. Instead of being assigned automatically, conversations stay in the queue until a service representative picks them up from their Inbox or a supervisor assigns them manually. This assignment method supports a pick-based work distribution model, giving supervisors and service representatives greater control over how work is handled. Unlike the push-based model used by other out-of-the-box assignment methods, which automatically assign conversations based on representative availability and capacity, the no auto assignment method allows teams to review incoming work and decide who should handle it. This approach is well suited for organizations that prefer manual oversight, specialized work selection, or supervisor-managed assignments. Business Value: Improve operational control and consistency by enabling service representative-led work distribution. Conversations remain available in the queue until manually assigned by supervisors or picked by representatives, helping teams handle specialized, regulated, or sensitive interactions effectively. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Workforce engagement management - Analyze adherence history to optimize workforce planning
items.description: The Adherence History Report provides a complete view of customer service representatives’ historical adherence to scheduled tasks and activities. It helps supervisors analyze patterns, identify gaps, and improve workforce efficiency. Key capabilities Trend chart : Visualize adherence patterns for individual service representatives or the entire team over time. Metrics dashboard : Track adherence percentage, total scheduled time, and time spent out of adherence. Activity summary view : Access detailed activity records for each service representative, including precise durations for granular analysis. You can find the Adherence History Report in the Copilot Service workspace by navigating to Workforce Management in the site map and selecting Adherence Historical Analytics . Business Value: Organizations can gain actionable insights into customer service representative adherence behavior over time. By analyzing trends and deviations, supervisors can make informed decisions to optimize workforce planning, reduce inefficiencies, and improve service-level compliance. Using these insights helps lead to better resource allocation, higher productivity, and an enhanced customer experience. Enabled for: Enabled by admins/makers/marketers for end users

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Opportunity acceleration - Chat about sales opportunity agent insights from inside Sales agent
items.description: As a seller, you can: Ask questions in context : Ask about opportunity research from Sales agent.
